title: 第21章 生男生女第22章 小公主

“傻楚……傻楚……”
是刘小燕的声音。
陈楚要起身，不过王翠再次把他压下去。
小声说：“不要管她，过一会儿就自己走了。”
但刘小燕在苞米地外不停的喊。
而且还一根垄、一根垄的找寻。
“傻楚，我知道你在苞米地呢，是不是昨天晚上太累了？在苞米地睡着了？”
刘小燕脚步轻快，一副不找到陈楚就誓不罢休的样子。
王翠狠狠瞪了陈楚一眼。
“你是不是把她给……那个了？”
“我……没……”
陈楚挠了挠头，闹了个大红脸。
“哼，被人女孩儿找上门了，还说没有？”
王翠起身。
走出苞米地。
嫣然一笑。
“小燕妹子，别喊了，陈楚正在吃饺子呢，刚才就没答应。”
说着，打量起小燕来。
王翠此时穿的是一身前凸后翘露大腿的旗袍。

刘小燕穿的是牛仔短裤，上面小体恤，小肚脐还露着。
两个女人站在那互相打量着。
陈楚端着一饭盒饺子出来。
呲牙笑。
“翠嫂子给我送饺子来了。”
……
“傻楚……”
远处，传了朱丽娜的一声呼唤。
王翠咯咯一笑：“看吧，正宫娘娘来了……”
刘小燕脸上一红。
朱丽娜穿了一身白色的热裤，轮廓看的更加清晰。
她干练的短发，磁性的声音，更为性感。
到了地头，见刘小燕是露大腿的短裤，王翠是前凸后翘的旗袍……
这两个女人，今天咋穿的这么骚？
朱丽娜走到陈楚跟前，一下挎住他的胳膊。
证明宣誓主权一样。
看向两人：“傻楚，刚才翠嫂子和小燕妹子都来咱家找你有事儿，你现在可是大忙人啊……”
王翠咯咯一笑：“傻楚帮我卖了不少白菜，我包了饺子给他送一份尝尝。”
然后看向刘小燕。
刘小燕忙说：“是我哥哥找他，傻楚会医术，我哥哥想请他救救我表姐。”

"Sichu...Sichu..."
It was Liu Xiaoyan’s voice.
Chen Chu wanted to get up, but Wang Cui pushed him down again.
Whispered: "Don't worry about her, she will leave by herself after a while."
But Liu Xiaoyan kept shouting outside Baomi Di.
And I searched ridge after ridge.
"Shachu, I know you are in Baomichi. Were you too tired last night? Did you fall asleep in Baomichi?"
Liu Xiaoyan walked briskly, as if she would not give up until she found Chen Chu.
Wang Cui glared at Chen Chu fiercely.
"Did you give her to... that?"
"I... didn't..."
Chen Chu scratched his head and blushed.
"Humph, a girl came to your door, and you still said no?"
Wang Cui stood up.
Get out of the corn field.
Smile sweetly.
"Sister Xiaoyan, stop shouting. Chen Chu is eating dumplings. He didn't agree just now."
As he said that, he looked at Xiaoyan.
Wang Cui was wearing a cheongsam with a protruding front and a raised back, exposing her thighs.
Liu Xiaoyan was wearing denim shorts with a small T-shirt on top, and her navel was still exposed.

Smiling with bared teeth.
"Sister-in-law Cui brought me dumplings."
…

Wang Cui chuckled: "Look, the Empress of the Palace is here..."
Liu Xiaoyan's face turned red.
Zhulina wore a pair of white hot pants, and her outline was clearer.
Her smart short hair and magnetic voice make her even more sexy.
When we arrived at the end of the field, we saw Liu Xiaoyan in shorts that exposed her thighs, and Wang Cui in a cheongsam with the front and back turned up...

Zhu Lina walked up to Chen Chu and took his arm.
It is the same as proving the oath of sovereignty.
He looked at the two of them: "Sichu, sister-in-law Cui and sister Xiaoyan came to our house just now to find something to do with you. You are a very busy person now..."

Then he looked at Liu Xiaoyan.
Liu Xiaoyan hurriedly said: "It's my brother who is looking for him. Shachu knows medical skills. My brother wants to ask him to save my cousin."
